The main takeaway from our work is that
CSE-MRI may be a useful method for monitoring VBM fat content changes in breast cancer patients receiving combined AI and BP treatment.
VBM PDFF changes can be assessed with CSE-based water–fat imaging in a clinical setting and may serve as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for AI and BP treatment effects.
